reuse.why: The change extends the existing month-fill helpers and reuses tag extraction, amount-sign conversion, budget writes, batching, and undo wrappers.

duplication.why: Eligibility rules remain centralized, and the new action shares category selection and sign conversion with existing actions.

placement.why: Selection and calculation remain in budget/actions.ts, with method registration and undo integration in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested month-wide actions, their eligibility rules, tests, and release documentation.

maintainability.why: The shared policy remains easy to locate and extend, although its growing positional parameter list and average-specific conversion name reduce clarity.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All affected month-wide actions use isMonthFillCategory directly or through getMonthFillCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The new action reuses the existing selection and sign-conversion definitions without reshaping their logic locally.

abstraction_drift.where: In actions.ts, isMonthFillCategory gains fixedGroupIds and includeHiddenCategories plus guards for hidden categories, saved templates, and fixed groups; getMonthFillCategories and setMonthAverage each gain includeHiddenCategories.
